companionJar.note: Bundled inside the installer as an embedded resource - built from this repository via .\gradlew.bat build. Never downloaded.

fabricLoader.note: Official Fabric Meta API. The returned JSON is the exact launcher version profile - it is fetched live at install time (not baked into this manifest) so library coordinates/hashes always come from Fabric's own authoritative source. Each library it lists is downloaded from https://maven.fabricmc.net/ and verified against the sha256 that same response provides.

knownGoodFallback.note: Fabric's profile response does not include a hash for the fabric-loader jar itself. This is our own independently-verified fallback hash, computed once from a real download, used only if the live response omits it again.

fabricApi.note: sha256/sizeBytes computed locally from a file whose sha512 was independently verified to match the value Modrinth's API itself publishes for this exact version.

statusLegend.VERIFIED: Built, real-launcher QA tested, and the only target this installer will actually install.
statusLegend.COMPATIBLE: Reserved for future releases believed to work but not yet fully QA-verified.
statusLegend.UNSUPPORTED: Reserved for future releases explicitly known not to work - the installer must refuse these.

policy: The installer must never install a Minecraft version/entry that is not present in this manifest with status VERIFIED. For this release, Minecraft 26.3 is the only supported target.
